# semaphore_ex_project_policy_guardrail_validate (Action)

Evaluates or compares policy guardrails without publishing or saving a policy. Executes only through explicit Action invocation. Progress reports a bounded, non-secret summary. Full preview results are available through the matching ephemeral resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "semaphore_ex_project_policy_guardrail_validate" "example" {
  config {
    project_id  = 1
    source_yaml = yamlencode({ version = 1, rules = [] })
  }
}

# terraform apply -invoke=action.semaphore_ex_project_policy_guardrail_validate.example
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (Number)
- `source_yaml` (String) Authored policy YAML to validate; yamlencode supports native HCL authoring.
